subject.title: refactor(channels): move inbound turn execution into core

question: Is the current-head test and CI evidence sufficient for this behavior-preserving multi-channel lifecycle refactor, or should the PR first add real Telegram proof for `31a2d2b25f43e6c7498028ee17ad23e106353724`?
rationale: The only supplied real Telegram recording validates an earlier commit, while the final head includes subsequent changes and the PR carries a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Capture current-head Telegram proof
options.body: Record or capture a redacted Telegram Desktop run from the final head that demonstrates an inbound turn and delivered reply, then retain the focused lifecycle tests as supplemental evidence.

options.title: Accept the supplied test-only proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused channel regressions and green gates as adequate for this behavior-preserving ownership refactor despite the proof commit mismatch.

recommendation.title: Capture current-head Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Record or capture a redacted Telegram Desktop run from the final head that demonstrates an inbound turn and delivered reply, then retain the focused lifecycle tests as supplemental evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete authored both the merged core-inbound predecessor and this continuation, and supplied the proposed proof rationale.
